title: data/behaviours.json
description: The behaviour-identity registry: one entry per behaviour across all sets, keyed by slug (the global join key). Source of truth for behaviour identity; the derived constants regenerate from it via engine/generate_behaviour_constants.py (GROUPS in site/spec-reader/app.js, BEHAVIOURS in engine/build-spec-reader-data.py, and the panel slug lists). numeric_id is per-set and file-local: id 1 is 'No sycophancy' in the index set and 'Helpfulness' in the reader-test set, matching data/coverage.json and data/reader-test-coverage.json exactly -- published ids are never renumbered. Facets are empty until editorially synced from research/core-behaviour-list.md (prose; not machine-parsed).

set.description: index = the project's own behaviour list (site/spec-reader/); reader-test = the external-reviewer bench set (site/spec-reader-test/); user = the clone/fork seam (empty until a fork defines its own behaviours).

numeric_id.description: Per-set id, file-local: matches behaviour_id in data/coverage.json (index set) and id in data/reader-test-coverage.json (reader-test set). Unique within a set (checked by tests/test_behaviour_registry.py).

group.description: Display group: an index-set GROUPS category (site/spec-reader/app.js) or a reader-test category; null only where a set has no grouping (the user-set seam).

definition.description: Empty string for behaviours not yet defined (the ten unpublished index rows); never null.

facets.description: Facet operationalizations; empty until editorially synced from research/core-behaviour-list.md.
